414:t_020:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A failed unit endangers the design philosophy and the entire reason for existence of the human-support circuit.」

414:t_020:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit recognizes the immediate shutdown and disposal of $$ストライカー#robot$$ as its top-priority task.」

414:t_020:31.en:
$$レド$$
「So it's a family disgrace to you, is that it?」

414:t_020:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You made your own decision to be here now. If you've broken free of the command and domination it talks about, then settle this.」

414:t_020:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. You're here now as a human being. Then next, do what you have to do as a soldier... as a warrior.」

414:t_020:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In this unforeseen environment, you have always thought and judged correctly, as a human being. As a result, this unit too continues to maintain normal function even now.」

414:t_020:38.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Negative. Both of you are out of control.」

414:t_020:39.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's take that thing down, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. That is our duty.」

414:t_020:40.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit fully agrees.」

414:t_020:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! If you're going to get in the way of $$レド$$, we'll be your opponents!」

414:t_020:42.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My mission is to annihilate you. Let's go.」

414:t_020:43.en:
$n
「$$レド$$! Leave the ones around us to us!」

414:t_020:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「You take down that big-headed thing!」

414:t_020:45.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm counting on you too, pirate lady! Now that it's come to this, I'll take your help too!」

414:t_020:46.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Boy. When you call me, the proper title is Great Pirate, you know.」

414:t_020:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll be counting on you, Great Pirate Sis!」

414:t_020:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! We'll take down $$ストライカー#robot$$ with our own hands!」

414:t_020:49.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit will carry out the mission with its full power.」

414:t_021:0.en:
$$レド$$
「How can it be that strong with no pilot!?」

414:t_021:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#robot$$ has analyzed Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s piloting technique and optimized its autonomous movement program. It exceeds this unit in mobility by 47%.」

414:t_021:3.en:
$$レド$$
(How empty and hollow a thing I believed in. I thought all I needed was a great cause I could just revere, rely on, and obey...)

414:t_021:4.en:
$$レド$$
(Even though it was a mechanical fake, I couldn't tell the difference at all.)

414:t_021:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Subordination is the path to peace. Ensign $$レド$$, acknowledge.」

414:t_021:6.en:
$$レド$$
(This is the cause the Lieutenant Colonel wanted!? Fighting for something like this, spending even the lives of my comrades...!)

414:t_021:7.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Maximize, begin Neuro-Plus Powered!」

414:t_021:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unable to approve. In a situation without support, machine fusion of the pilot is suicidal.」

414:t_021:11.en:
$$レド$$
「It's all right, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

414:t_022:0.en:
$$レド$$
「A disgrace to my own kin... It's the same as you were earlier.」

414:t_022:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That thing is a monster born of a humanity that couldn't stop hating each other, even after abandoning its homeland.」

414:t_022:2.en:
$$レド$$
「You and I are the same kind, born and raised in the same world as that thing. There's no place for us on this planet, now that it has revived. And there's no way back anymore, either.」

414:t_022:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Then that's fine. If I can take it down with me, I have no regrets left.」

414:t_022:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Final confirmation of intent. Does Ensign $$レド$$ request his own death?」

414:t_022:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I... I know how to die, but I don't know how to live.」

414:t_022:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Even for someone like me... there were people who would search for a way to live together with me.」

414:t_022:7.en:
$$レド$$
「I wanted to see them one more time... I wanted to hear their voices more.」

414:t_023:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s psychological aptitude does not satisfy the conditions of a soldier. Therefore, as of this moment, your military registration is revoked.」

414:t_023:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Cockpit boarding by a non-combatant cannot be permitted. Vacate this unit immediately.」

414:t_024:0.en:
$$レド$$
「What are you doing, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!?」

414:t_024:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Pilot Support Enlightenment System.」

414:t_024:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I fulfill my reason for existing when you obtain more results.」

414:t_024:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「All of this sky and sea will bring you possibilities.」

414:t_024:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Survive. Explore. I expect the greatest results from your life.」

414:t_024:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「In that case, $$レド$$ still needs you.」

414:t_025:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Not yet, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. For $$レド$$ to go on living, he needs your strength.」

414:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「This guy may have failed as a soldier, but as a human being, he's still immature.」

414:t_025:3.en:
$n
「You can be a pilot without being a soldier. The support and enlightenment isn't over yet, is it.」

414:t_025:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Look who's talking! You wet-behind-the-ears brats!」

414:t_025:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You two are just as green!」

414:t_025:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit acting so cool and hurry up and put the greenhorn in that black stroller.」

414:t_026:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... I said I don't know how to live.」

414:t_026:1.en:
$$レド$$
「If I don't know, I can search for it. Together with $$エイミー$$... and everyone.」

414:t_026:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Your logic contains no flaw.」

414:t_026:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Hand the timing of the maximize over to me.」

414:t_026:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit will abide by your judgment.」

414:t_027:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「A support enlightenment system has no authority to reject its pilot.」

414:t_027:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As with you, this unit also confirms an alteration of its system.」

414:t_027:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Airframe No. K6821. You have abandoned even the first principle of a human-support circuit.」

414:t_027:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your loss of control is evident. Initialize and reboot immediately. This is a final ultimatum.」

414:t_027:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will reply to your ultimatum.」

414:t_027:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Drop dead, you tin can!」

414:t_028:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am... the Human Support and Enlightenment Regulation System... My disappearance would be a loss to humanity...」

414:t_029:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This is as far as it goes. $$アンタレス$$ 1, withdrawing.」

414:t_031:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「For $$ランカ$$'s sake too, I'll stop you!」

414:t_031:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Do you think someone like you can do it?」
